messages.author: 82933c06b1097cc4
messages.subject: merge linkage maps from multiple populations
parts:
Hello,

Does anybody know if Rqtl can merge linkage maps from multi-populations? Both genotyping data and linkage maps are available.
Thank you
Gill

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] merge linkage maps from multiple populations
parts:
By "merge", do you mean estimate a joint map from data on multiple populations?

I'd say no, except in the simplest circumstance that the populations are all the same type of cross (e.g., a set of intercrosses).

karl
